findings.detail: Manual workflow accepted a free-form goal, granted contents:write and pull-requests:write, read GROQ_API_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, CHATGPT_TOKEN and GITHUB_TOKEN, invoked scripts/barrot_task_allocator.py, and committed/pushed allocation results. No tested nine-platform adapters or verified live provider collaboration existed. Proposed branch version is inert with empty permissions and no secret references.

Daily 00:00 UTC schedule plus manual dispatch supplied KAGGLE_USERNAME and KAGGLE_KEY. It invoked a nonexistent repository-root kaggle_competitions_automation.py; the actual scripts are under scripts/ and barrot_agent/tools/. The latest scheduled failure previously recorded in PR #1539 stopped at the missing path before script execution, so no submission was made in that run. A future path correction would turn the latent scheduled submission capability live. Proposed branch version is inert, removes schedule and credentials, and has empty permissions pending protected-environment review.

decisions: Disable unverified provider orchestration until capability/authentication/permission/data-flow adapters are independently tested.
Disable scheduled Kaggle submissions until a protected GitHub Environment with required reviewers, exact competition slug allowlist, reproducible script path and per-run approval are verified.
Do not use a workflow input alone as equivalent to independent reviewer approval.
